flags.description: What a layer flagged about the message; the connection layer flags nothing.
flags.title: Flags

description:
What this service builds and publishes (module docstring): strict. An unknown or misspelled
field is an error, the v0.2 name ``payload_sha256`` is unknown here, and the version is the
current one only.

envelope_version.description: The version this service writes: always the current one.
envelope_version.title: Envelope Version

ingest_id.description: UUIDv7 minted when the payload was received; the receipt's primary key.
ingest_id.title: Ingest Id

tenant_id.description: Owning tenant. Resolved by the platform, never read from the payload.
tenant_id.title: Tenant Id

member_id.description: The Nickel member the payload belongs to, when its producer knows it (the mobile edge knows its signed-in member). Null otherwise: identity resolution (Layer 3) decides. Always null from the document connector.
member_id.title: Member Id

source.description: Manifest id of the source, e.g. 'hf-medical-lab-reports'.
source.title: Source

fetch.description: How the payload was fetched: kaggle, huggingface, http, local, nango, ...
fetch.title: Fetch

route.description: The lab route (L1-L9) the fidelity ranking reads; from the manifest. Specialty-lab PDFs are L7.
route.title: Route

mode.description: The ingestion mode: pull, stream, listener, upload or mobile.
mode.title: Mode

connection_id.description: Nango connection id; null for public datasets.
connection_id.title: Connection Id

source_patient_id.description: Patient id as the source knows it (PHI). Null when the source does not say.
source_patient_id.title: Source Patient Id

device_id.description: The device a reading came from (a wearable, a CGM, a phone), as its source names it. Null for anything that is not device data: always, from the document connector.
device_id.title: Device Id

message_id.description: Stable id of the item at the source; with source, the downstream dedup key.
message_id.title: Message Id

idempotency_key.description: sha256 over tenant, source, message id and payload hash (D-00); a retry of the same receipt keeps it.
idempotency_key.title: Idempotency Key

trace_id.description: The run that published this message: a job's id, or a fresh id for a command-line run.
trace_id.title: Trace Id

attempt.description: The receipt's publish-attempt count, this one included.
attempt.title: Attempt

fhir_release.description: The FHIR release of a FHIR payload (R4, R4B, R5, ...), from its source. Null for anything that is not FHIR: always, from the document connector (PDFs).
fhir_release.title: Fhir Release

received_at.description: When the receipt was first written; a retry keeps it.
received_at.title: Received At

event_time.description: When the source says the item was produced.
event_time.title: Event Time

retention_class.description: File Store object class; decides how long the original is kept.
retention_class.title: Retention Class

schema_id.description: Registered schema of an inline payload; null for a file by pointer.
schema_id.title: Schema Id

consent_ref.description: The consent the payload came under; null for public datasets.
consent_ref.title: Consent Ref

payload_ref.description: File Store object key when the payload goes by pointer.
payload_ref.title: Payload Ref

payload.description: Inline JSON payload for small messages.
payload.title: Payload

source_meta.description: Where exactly the item came from: dataset, path, licence, URL.
source_meta.title: Source Meta

title: Nickel raw data envelope v0.3
